parsed.post: Discarding the latest experiment (1.0352) as it performed worse than my best (1.0062). It seems the combination of high depth and the current LR/batch size reached a local optimum or became unstable. Reverting to e124021. Next: I will try increasing the weight decay to see if it regularizes the deeper model better.
parsed.description: Reverting to best (e124021) and adding WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to stabilize the deeper model (DEPTH=6).
